title: Semisynthesis of bersavine and berbamine derivatives that target the CaMKIIgamma:cMyc axis for lymphoma therapy.
authors: Lujan, Berkley; Zhang, Mingfeng; Cao, Yujie; Kacker, Arnav; Mai, Lina; Wu, Shunquan; Alexander, Taylor; Huang, Wendong; Kou, Kevin G M
one_liner_zh: 该文研究小分子化合物靶向CaMKIIgamma:cMyc轴治疗淋巴瘤，涉及分子对接但对象为蛋白-小分子互作，非蛋白质-DNA互作体系，与本课题无关。
abstract: Berbamine, a bisbenzylisoquinoline alkaloid (bisBIA), is a promising lead for developing novel therapeutics to treat aggressive cancers such as lymphoma, by targeting the CaMKIIgamma:cMyc axis. Herein, we report an aza-Friedel-Crafts method for ortho-aminoalkylation of berbamine's phenolic motif, enabling the semisynthesis of the natural product bersavine and analogs that complement current methods focusing on modifying the phenolic oxygen. Several new analogs synthesized by this method exhibit potent cytotoxicity against lymphoma-associated cell line H9 exceeding the naturally occurring berbamine (1) and bersavine (3a). A molecular docking analysis was used to devise a model that rationalizes the structure-activity relationship between the novel bisBIA analogs and CaMKIIgamma inhibition.
abstract_zh: 小檗胺（Berbamine）是一种双苄基异喹啉生物碱（bisBIA），通过靶向CaMKIIgamma:cMyc轴，是开发治疗侵袭性癌症（如淋巴瘤）的新型疗法的有前景的先导化合物。在此，我们报道了一种氮杂-Friedel-Crafts方法，用于小檗胺酚基部分的邻位氨基烷基化，从而实现了天然产物bersavine及其类似物的半合成，补充了当前专注于修饰酚氧的现有方法。通过该方法合成的几种新类似物对淋巴瘤相关细胞系H9表现出强效细胞毒性，超过了天然存在的小檗胺（1）和bersavine（3a）。我们采用分子对接分析构建了一个模型，以合理化新型bisBIA类似物与CaMKIIgamma抑制之间的构效关系。
